title: Live Wire — EN/ES/FR (Pete McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
You walk into the room, you don't walk in — you arrive
Some people light a lamp, Pete hooks up the live
Seven years on Corey, more on Joel below
But age don't slow the current, it just changes how it flows

[Verse 2 — Español]
Subiendo escaleras con clavo y pistola, riendo en la altura [Up a ladder with a nail gun, laughing at the height]
Pelícano en la popa ahora, riendo en la luz madura [Pelican on the stern now, laughing at the mature light]
El mismo voltaje, diferente circuito — el hombre no pierde su carga [Same voltage, different circuit — the man doesn't lose his charge]
Ya sea en el tejado o en el barco allá en la larga [Whether on the rooftop or on the boat out far]

[Chorus — English]
Live wire, live wire
He comes in hot and the room gets higher
Oldest one, the one who set the bar
Pete McIvor — that's who you are

[Bridge — Français]
Chas disait — petit, ralentis un peu [Chas used to say — kid, slow down a little]
Mais Chas savait mieux — un câble vif n'a pas besoin de couronne [But Chas knew better — a live wire needs no crown]
Il lui faut juste l'eau, il lui faut juste le ciel [He just needs the water, he just needs the sky]
On n'éteint pas un câble vif — on le regarde voler [You can't turn off a live wire — you just watch him fly]

[Verse 3 — English]
Live wire never quits, oldest never stops
Pete Capitán — from the rooftop to the docks

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Live wire
Cable vivo [Live wire]
Câble vif [Live wire]
That's my boy
